Editorial Note This is a digital reproduction of “The Book of Analysis”, a translation of the second book of the Abhidhamma—the Vibha˙nga—by U Thit.t.ila, which was ﬁrst published in 1969. While I tried to produce an exact copy of the original text, some changes were introduced: • Internal links were added, so that readers can easily click the numerous references. • A bibliography was added. • The table of contents was moved to the front of the book. • Obvious oversights and errors were corrected, all of them minor. The pagination of the original PTS edition can be found on the margins. Unless the page begins on a new paragraph, a vertical bar indicates the beginning of the new page.
